segments.name: Cloudflare
segments.description: Delivers integrated cloud-based security, performance, and reliability services across a global network to businesses and consumers.
segments.evidence: We deliver a suite of deeply integrated products that serve as a unified control plane for our customers, allowing them to build, connect, and secure applications and corporate infrastructure.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription and support fees recognized over time for use of the company's global network and products.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscription and support revenue is recognized over time and accounted for substantially all of the Company's revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023.
